problem: Translate pretrained video-model motion knowledge into real manipulation without task-specific robot demonstrations or learned robot action heads.
contribution: NovaFlow uses calibrated3D object flow as an intermediate plan and an embodiment-specific geometric/dynamics executor. Primary title matches NovaFlow: Zero-Shot Manipulation via Actionable Flow from Generated Videos. Demonstration-free task execution does not mean every component is untrained: deformable execution uses trainedPhysTwin dynamics.
algorithm: Generate candidate videos from initialRGBD/language, optionally goalimage. MegaSaM depth is median-scaled to measured initial depth; TAPIP3D tracks points; GroundedSAM2 isolates object trajectories. A VLM ranks flow visualizations. Rigid flow is fit with KabschSE3 then composed withGraspGen grasp transform and optimized joint trajectory. Deformable flow supplies correspondence cost for particle-dynamicsMPC.
observations: Known intrinsics, actual initial depth, RGB and instruction; optional user/model-generated goal image. Real rigid/articulated setup usesD455; deformables use three synchronized cameras forPhysTwin. Generated geometry is fallible and live tracking is not part of demonstrated rigid open-loop executor.
actions: Robot-specific Cartesian grasp/trajectory and joint optimization onFrankaRobotiq85 orSpot; constrained start/end/joint/collision terms are solved as costs withLevenbergMarquardt. Planned constraints do not guarantee successful collision-free physical tracking.
embodiment_and_data: Six real tasks cover mughanging, blockinsertion, cup/saucer, watering, drawer and rope. Randomized object placement,10trials/task. Modular pretrainedWan2.1/Veo, depth/tracking/segmentation/grasp models and trained particle model have separate prerequisites/licenses.
experiments: Compares demonstration-freeAVDC adapted to generated videos andVidBot, plusDP10/30demos andIDM30demos. Precision tasks can use goal images. Eight video candidates per trial are VLM-ranked, so selected execution success differs from success of one generated video. Runtime measured onH100, not embeddedGPU.
baselines: AVDC(*) changes its normalpipeline;VidBot;DiffusionPolicy10/30taskdemos;UniPi-styleIDM trainedrealvideos but testedgeneratedvideos, a noted domainshift. Preserve these qualifications rather than claiming equal-data universal superiority.
quantitative_result: Figure7 PDFp8:60trials→56flowsuccess→51graspsuccess→44tasksuccess, with2video/2tracking/5grasp/7execution failures. limitations: Open-loop rigid execution, occlusion/textureless tracking, hallucinated geometry, grasp slip and actual collisions/joint limits dominate failures. Deformable model needs training and multipleviews. Goalimage/rejectionbudget influences precision results. Small10trial tasks and pretrained-model dependence limit extrapolation.
code_and_license: No repository/model/data license text was independently inspected. Wan,Veo,MegaSaM,TAPIP3D,SAM2,GraspGen andPhysTwin cannot be assigned one inferred license. No code inspected/executed.
